messages.text:
Implemented the TanStack Start POWERPROMPT marketplace in the current directory.

Changed/added key files:
- `package.json:1` — real dev/build/start/test scripts and dependencies.
- `vite.config.ts:1` — TanStack Start Vite wiring.
- `src/router.tsx:1`, `src/client.tsx:1`, `src/ssr.tsx:1` — Start/router entries.
- `src/routes/index.tsx:1` — storefront route with filters/search/sort.
- `src/routes/prompts.$promptId.tsx:1` — prompt detail/lightbox-style preview route.
- `src/routes/cart.tsx:1` — cart and checkout simulation.
- `src/routes/admin.tsx:1` — creator/admin analytics.
- `src/components.tsx:1` — sidebar, sticky filters, masonry cards, save/cart actions, cart/admin views.
- `src/styles.css:1` — POWERPROMPT visual system, responsive sidebar/drawer/dock, masonry gallery, hover overlays.
- `src/server/db.ts:1` — SQLite schema and seed data: 12 prompts, 4 creators, categories, user/cart/favorites/orders.
- `src/server/queries.ts:1` — SQL-backed ranking, counts, cart totals, revenue, conversion, AOV, category and daily trend calculations.
- `src/server/functions.ts:1` — TanStack Start server functions.
- `tests/db.test.ts:1`, `tests/api.test.ts:1`, `tests/e2e/storefront.spec.ts:1` — database, backend behavior, and browser smoke tests.
- `public/media/prompts/*` — local generated/inspected card media.

Verified locally:
- `npm install` — passed, 0 vulnerabilities.
- `npm run build` — passed.
- `npm run test:db` — passed, 3 tests.
- `npm run test:api` — passed, 2 tests.
- `npm run test:e2e` — passed, 1 Chromium browser flow.

Run it:
- Dev: `npm run dev`
- Local URL: `http://127.0.0.1:3000`
- Built server: `npm run build && npm run start`

The app is now a real TanStack Start full-stack app, not an iframe/static dump, with SQLite persistence and backend-calculated marketplace metrics.
